scripts.dist: next build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$stage='..\PassGen-electron-app'; if (Test-Path $stage) { Remove-Item $stage -Recurse -Force }; New-Item $stage -ItemType Directory | Out-Null; Copy-Item electron-app\package.json $stage\package.json; Copy-Item electron-app\package-lock.json $stage\package-lock.json; Copy-Item electron-app\main.cjs $stage\main.cjs; Copy-Item out $stage\out -Recurse; corepack pnpm exec electron-builder --win portable --config.directories.app=$stage"
